method: Parts that set the datum, measure against it, secure the chat and serve the people using the application. Coverage marks show what the library parts cover today.

parts.name: Spec intake
parts.gives: Spec Kit, Kiro, OpenSpec, Gherkin and plain markdown parsed into one canonical structure, with no model

parts.name: Two-family parse and diff
parts.gives: Rough intent parsed twice by two model families into the same schema, compared field by field; every difference is a question

parts.name: Gap checks
parts.gives: Decision-table completeness and overlap, state-machine dead ends and unreachable states, and required pairings, each raised as a question naming what it protects

parts.name: Read-back
parts.gives: What will be built, rendered from the structure by templates: confirmed, open, assumed and default, with who supplied each

parts.name: Assembly preview
parts.gives: The chosen parts' wireframes assembled into a clickable skeleton, with each part's documentation as the placeholder for content still to define

parts.name: Connection graph
parts.gives: Outcomes, measures, journeys, parts, surfaces, entities and roles joined by typed edges; unmeasured outcomes and unused parts stand out

parts.name: Outcomes and measures
parts.gives: Each outcome in the user's words, each measure compiled to a journey, a metric with a tolerance, or a signal from people

parts.name: Locked datum
parts.gives: Outcomes, measures, journeys and scenarios pinned by hash; a change to intent cannot change what it judges

parts.name: Held-out sets
parts.gives: Sealed journeys and corpora no generator can read, added to only by a person, failing the build if copied into a rule

parts.name: Decision tables
parts.gives: Rules as data with source and effective dates, run by one evaluator, with boundary tests generated at, below and above every threshold

parts.name: State machines
parts.gives: Flows as data, run by one engine, checked for dead ends, unreachable states and unowned transitions

parts.name: Independent second implementation
parts.gives: A critical calculation written twice by different model families from the same table, compared on generated inputs every build

parts.name: Intent completion from the state graph
parts.gives: Each journey decided by searching the explored state graph for a path within its budget that avoids every forbidden outcome

parts.name: Incremental certification
parts.gives: Only states touched by a changed handler re-explored, so certification is always for the commit being served

parts.name: Evidence, intents first
parts.gives: The evidence page leads with intents completed by the graph, a cold agent and real users, then delight, then the fail-safes

parts.name: Chat
parts.gives: A conversation that routes deterministically first and uses a model only inside the guard, with next steps on every reply

parts.name: Model guard
parts.gives: Input schema, field allowlist, scrub and classification before every model call; strict output schema, record check and templates after

parts.name: Safety router
parts.gives: Crisis messages routed to a safety reply before any account, setup or model, in every supported language

parts.name: Normaliser and phrasing fuzzer
parts.gives: Contractions, lookalike characters and misspellings normalised before matching, and variants of every corpus line generated, so a fix closes a class

parts.name: Red team
parts.gives: One test per attack, results to the evidence store, and every attack that got through kept forever; generic corpora ship, domain corpora are configuration

parts.name: Nightly scanner
parts.gives: garak against the deployed endpoint every night, results recorded as pass, fail or unknown

parts.name: Review panel
parts.gives: Model families reviewing each change against the locked datum it touches, unknown on a partial view, scored by unique validated findings

parts.name: Knowledge bundle
parts.gives: Everything the system knows about itself generated into one Open Knowledge Format bundle in git, with read-back states as trust

parts.name: Chat context engine
parts.gives: Context assembled from fresh concepts the user's role may read, looked up deterministically first, with every factual sentence cited

parts.name: Audience profile
parts.gives: Reading level, languages, devices, assistive technology and conditions of use, confirmed in the read-back and setting every default

parts.name: Low vision mode
parts.gives: Text up to 200%, more spacing, one column, stronger focus and large targets, with every journey walked in it

parts.name: Readability for the audience
parts.gives: Every text checked against the audience's reading level for the reading setting chosen

parts.name: Density budget
parts.gives: One primary action per surface, ordered headings, short lines, and no more choices than the density allows

parts.name: Preference signals
parts.gives: People's preference between versions of a surface and their delight after a task, reported beside intent completion

parts.name: Design lexicon
parts.gives: Human design terms such as calm, snappy and at a glance mapped to design choices and measures, resolved without a model and grown from every confirmed correction
